five_turn_method.overlay: S_k(theta)=sum_{j=0}^{4} x_{k+j}(theta), k advances by one revolution
five_turn_method.split_repeatability: weighted correlation of cell means from alternating 10-stacked-turn blocks
five_turn_method.null: 64 circular shifts by whole stacked turns, preserving device phase and stacked-signal autocorrelation while changing ICRS registry
five_turn_method.harmonics: real spherical harmonics through degree 12 with weak Laplacian-squared ridge

coverage.registration: Each 5-turn elementwise sum is assigned to the effective UTC and ICRS direction of its center revolution.
